## Checklist

- [ ] The branch is named `<type>/<kebab-case-description>` and the title is a Conventional Commit.
- [ ] A behaviour change comes with a test (a bug fix starts with a failing test).
- [ ] `dotnet format NotionMultiMcp.slnx --verify-no-changes`, `dotnet build` and `dotnet test` pass.
- [ ] README, `docs/development.md` and `docs/architecture.md` are updated if they describe what changed.
- [ ] No token, password, signing key or log containing one is in the diff or in this description.
